internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: pressing another toward an action by active urging or incitement
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Two base-form verbs negate urging the feeding of the poor; Form VI negates mutual urging. All three keep motivational pressure toward action.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Form VI adds reciprocity, and complements supply the urged action. Negation evaluates absence of urging, not a different root meaning.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: All occurrences are negative and concern one charitable action, limiting polarity and domain diversity.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The root means command; mutual urging and motivational context favor pressure/encouragement rather than authoritative command.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from ordering by its interpersonal motivational pressure and from reminding, which need not press toward action.
internal_discovery.rationale: Universal within three occurrences, but sparse, negative-only evidence limits strength.
